java.io.File outputFile = outputPath.resolve("output.png").toFile();
net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.io.FileImageSink sink = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.io.FileImageSink(outputFile);

byte[] data = new byte[] { 10, 20, 30, 40 };
try (java.io.OutputStream os = sink.createOutputStream(outputFile)) {
    os.write(data);
} catch (java.io.IOException e) {
    throw new RuntimeException("Failed to create or write to output stream", e);
}

assert outputFile.exists() : "Output file should have been created";
assert outputFile.length() == data.length : "Output file should contain the exact written bytes";

System.out.println("__CHECK__ createOutputStream " + outputFile.length());
